question: Four letter-clusters have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd letter-cluster.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ea82bd5c97415b6a0bb4a31c9208d4af49dfee9c43ef8ee84e3fd4a2b56e847.png] 

The logic followed here is:

(1): [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/160798e94fd0a78708b6644f158b774b5e439037fb582947613d2478cb4ad231.png] ** **

(2): [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/363138ccdf2b3b78d466ff0785a9c1ff74a2a4b1c0546d10bd166068246091ac.png] 

(3): [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee492c64f0085925371ea49fdb4d1fbf79955cb20f73316983a48cd231c0db1a.png] 

(4): [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/046c9c9c40709d1b71f61ccb47639acc69277de7f4b93483a0766208263d591e.png] 

As, EFK, CDI, and ABG** follow the same logic **and GHN does not. **So, GHN is different.**

Hence, The correct answer is **"GHN".**
